title: ET SCAN Potential SSH Scan
author: Emerging Threats
description: Detects rapid SSH connection attempts characteristic of scanning tools.
rule_body: alert tcp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET 22 (msg:"ET SCAN Potential SSH Scan"; flow:to_server; flags:S,12; threshold: type both, track by_src, count 5, seconds 120; classtype:attempted-recon; sid:2001219; rev:20;)

title: ET MALWARE Meterpreter Reverse HTTPS Connection
author: Emerging Threats
description: Detects Meterpreter reverse HTTPS staging pattern.
rule_body: alert tls $HOME_NET any -> $EXTERNAL_NET any (msg:"ET MALWARE Meterpreter Reverse HTTPS"; flow:established,to_server; tls.sni; content:!"."; classtype:trojan-activity; sid:2018274; rev:6;)

title: Community WEB-PHP Suspicious Web Shell Upload
author: Snort Community
description: Detects upload of common PHP web-shell signatures (c99, r57, WSO).
rule_body: alert tcp any any -> $HTTP_SERVERS $HTTP_PORTS (msg:"COMMUNITY WEB-PHP Web Shell Upload"; flow:established,to_server; content:"eval(base64_decode"; nocase; http_client_body; classtype:web-application-attack; sid:1000501; rev:3;)

title: ET DNS Query to a *.top Suspicious TLD
author: Emerging Threats
description: DNS query to .top TLD frequently abused by C2 infrastructure.
rule_body: alert udp $HOME_NET any -> any 53 (msg:"ET DNS Query .top TLD"; content:"|03|top|00|"; fast_pattern; classtype:bad-unknown; sid:2027045; rev:3;)

title: ET EXPLOIT Apache log4j RCE (CVE-2021-44228)
author: Emerging Threats
description: Detects Log4Shell JNDI LDAP/RMI/DNS lookups in HTTP headers.
rule_body: alert http any any -> $HTTP_SERVERS any (msg:"ET EXPLOIT log4j JNDI"; content:"${jndi:"; nocase; http_header; classtype:attempted-admin; sid:2034647; rev:4;)

title: ET POLICY Curl User-Agent Outbound
author: Emerging Threats
description: Detects outbound HTTP with curl/wget user-agent from workstation nets.
rule_body: alert http $HOME_NET any -> $EXTERNAL_NET any (msg:"ET POLICY curl/wget User-Agent"; flow:established,to_server; http.user_agent; content:"curl/"; classtype:policy-violation; sid:2013028; rev:11;)

title: ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon HTTP Stager
author: Emerging Threats
description: Detects default Cobalt Strike HTTP staging pattern.
rule_body: alert http $HOME_NET any -> $EXTERNAL_NET any (msg:"ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon"; flow:established,to_server; content:"GET"; http_method; content:"/dpixel"; http_uri; classtype:trojan-activity; sid:2028700; rev:5;)

title: Community WEB-MISC Generic SQL Injection
author: Snort Community
description: Detects a generic UNION-SELECT SQLi payload in a URI.
rule_body: alert tcp any any -> $HTTP_SERVERS $HTTP_PORTS (msg:"COMMUNITY WEB-MISC SQL Injection UNION SELECT"; flow:to_server,established; content:"union select"; nocase; http_uri; classtype:web-application-attack; sid:1000601; rev:2;)
